shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && printf '\\n-- files --\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | head -200 && printf '\\n-- agent instructions --\\n' && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n-- page --\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n-- layout --\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n-- next after export --\\n' && rg 'function after|export.*after' node_modules/next/dist/server node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "find __agent_eval__ -maxdepth 2 -type f -print -exec sed -n '1,240p' {} \\; && printf '\\n-- tsconfig --\\n' && cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n-- after types --\\n' && cat node_modules/next/dist/server/after/after.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx lib/analytics.ts tsconfig.json && nl -ba app/page.tsx && nl -ba lib/analytics.ts'

/bin/bash -lc 'git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- app/page.tsx && git diff --no-index /dev/null lib/analytics.ts || true'
